propositions: Current clarity measure duplicates logic across two files and rewards volume/legacy shape rather than author-guide contract compliance, allowing padded tickets to pass without required sections.

Deterministic clarity checks should map documented plan-writing guidance to mechanically testable rules: required sections by graph altitude, per-AC verification coverage, placeholder detection, grounded scope with file_impact, AC text hygiene, and optional Testing shape markers.
Clarity scoring should derive from named applicable checks and evidence rather than accumulating points on a fixed scale, preventing filler from compensating for missing required sections.

Author guide and authoritative review criteria conflict on Success Criteria (containers should use Acceptance Criteria) and rejected-alternative prose requirements, creating ambiguity until documented guidance is unified.
